title: 第25章 词条进阶第26章 气血能量
content_zh:
大厅内死寂一片，没有一个人后退。
都已经走到了这一步，谁会甘心放弃跨越阶级的机会？
这可都是自己争取来的名额，旁人羡慕还来不及呢。
江岳面无表情地脱下衣物，露出那具经力压榨后，线条如同刀劈斧凿般致密精悍的躯体，直接躺入了医疗舱内。
舱盖无声闭合，冰冷且粘稠的高浓度幽蓝色营养液瞬间从四周涌出，将江岳彻底淹没。
“注射开始。”
伴随着主控台的指令，医疗舱内部的机械臂探出，冰冷的注射针头精准地刺入了江岳的颈动脉。
那一管散发着迷离光晕的【初级基因强化液】，被毫不留情地全量推入了血管！
轰！
药液入体的瞬间，江岳原本平稳的呼吸猛地一滞。
他感觉到一股极致的冰冷顺着血管直冲心脏，紧接着，这股冰冷在心脏的泵动下，瞬间化作了足以将灵魂都点燃的恐怖岩浆！
剧痛！无法用言语形容的剧痛！
这种痛楚不是来自于肌肉的撕裂，而是来自于微观层面的毁灭。
江岳仿佛能听见自己体内数以万亿计的细胞在集体哀嚎。
他那原本显得有些单薄的基因链，正在这股霸道的药力下，被毫不留情地暴力拆解！
如果是从小打磨底子的人，这种重组或许只是顺水推舟，但对于江岳这具“底色”极差的躯壳来说，药效实在太过猛烈了！
“滴滴滴——警告！实验体心率突破临界值！产生严重排异反应！”
剧烈的应激反应让江岳的身体在营养液中疯狂抽搐。
而就在这生死一线的危机关头，江岳视网膜深处的面板，终于被这股外来的庞大能量彻底激活！
【行为：进食——词条【化食】启动！】

【当前状态：+++】
在【化食】的底层逻辑判定中，只要是进入体内的能量，哪怕是狂暴的基因药剂，也同样属于食物的一种！
原本隐藏在胃部的虚幻熔炉轰然运转，试图将这股撕裂基因的药力强行消化平抚。
然而，两者之间的能量等级差距太大了！
“撑不住了……”
剧痛让江岳的意识开始模糊，但他那双在营养液中睁开的眼睛，却死死盯着虚空中的面板，眼底爆发出一种如野兽般极其病态的贪婪与疯狂。
“给我吃下去……这么庞大的能量……”
“老子在重力室里拿命换来的东西……一点都不准浪费！！”
“给我吃！！！”
极度的不甘与疯狂的掠夺意志，在这一刻化作了实质般的执念，不断催动着身体运转。
面板深处，传来了一声只有江岳能听见的清脆碎裂声。
【进阶成功！】
【暴食（绿色）】！
【描述：任何进补的高阶能量（高阶药剂、毒素、异兽血精、微量辐射等），皆可被强行剥离杂质，转化为最纯粹的生命底蕴。吸收利用率达到100%，且无视任何生物耐药性！消化速度提升！】
【可海量储存当前无法消化的溢出能量，并在战斗或枯竭时瞬间反哺爆发！】
当这抹幽幽的绿光亮起的瞬间，江岳体内那原本濒临失控的基因药力，就像是遇到了真正的天敌！
原本只能勉强磨碎能量的胃部，此刻化作了一个恐怖的微型黑洞。
霸道！蛮横！不讲道理的吞噬！
【暴食】词条仅仅是微微一转，那在血管里横冲直撞的幽蓝色药力便被瞬间扯碎，以一种极其骇人的速度，被强行压榨吸收，完美地融入了江岳每一寸正在重组的基因链中！
content_en:
There was dead silence in the hall, and no one stepped back.
Having already come this far, who would be willing to give up the opportunity to transcend class?
These are the places that you have earned yourself, and it is not too late for others to envy you.
Jiang Yue took off his clothes expressionlessly, revealing a body that was as dense and powerful as a knife and an ax after being squeezed by the force, and lay directly into the medical cabin.
The hatch closed silently, and the cold and viscous high-concentration blue nutrient solution instantly poured out from all sides, completely submerging Jiang Yue.
"Injection begins."
Following the instructions from the main console, the robotic arm inside the medical cabin reached out, and the cold injection needle accurately penetrated Jiang Yue's carotid artery.
The tube of [Primary Gene Enhancement Fluid] that exuded a blurry halo was pushed into the blood vessel in full without mercy!
boom!
The moment the medicine entered his body, Jiang Yue's originally steady breathing suddenly stagnated.
He felt an extreme coldness running down his blood vessels and straight into his heart. Then, under the pumping of his heart, this coldness instantly turned into terrifying magma that could ignite his soul!
Severe pain! Pain that cannot be described in words!
This pain does not come from the tearing of muscles, but from the destruction at the microscopic level.
Jiang Yue seemed to be able to hear the trillions of cells in his body wailing collectively.
His genetic chain, which originally seemed a bit weak, was violently and mercilessly dismantled under the power of this overbearing medicine!
If you are someone who has polished your foundation since childhood, this kind of reorganization may be just a smooth process, but for Jiang Yue, a body with a very poor "understanding", the effect of the medicine is too strong!
"Didi-di-warning! The subject's heart rate exceeds the critical value! Severe rejection reaction occurs!"
The severe stress reaction caused Jiang Yue's body to twitch crazily in the nutrient solution.
And at this critical moment of life and death, the panel deep in Jiang Yue's retina was finally fully activated by this huge external energy!
[Behavior: Eating—the entry [Transformation of Food] is activated! 】
[Current status: +++]
In the underlying logical judgment of [Food Transformation], as long as it is energy entering the body, even if it is a violent genetic medicine, it is also a type of food!
The illusory furnace originally hidden in the stomach was roaring, trying to forcibly digest and smooth out the power of the gene-tearing medicine.
However, the energy level gap between the two is too big!
"I can't hold it any longer..."
The severe pain made Jiang Yue's consciousness begin to blur, but his eyes, which were opened in the nutrient solution, were staring at the panel in the void, with an extremely morbid greed and madness like a beast bursting out from his eyes.
"Eat it for me...such a huge amount of energy..."
"What I bought with my life in the gravity chamber... must not be wasted at all!!"
"Eat it for me!!!"
The extreme unwillingness and crazy will to plunder turned into substantial obsession at this moment, constantly urging the body to operate.
Deep in the panel, there was a clear cracking sound that only Jiang Yue could hear.
[Advanced successfully! 】
[Gluttony (green)]!
[Description: Any high-level energy tonic (high-level potions, toxins, blood essence of alien animals, trace amounts of radiation, etc.) can be forcibly stripped of impurities and transformed into the purest life essence. The absorption and utilization rate reaches 100%, and it ignores any biological resistance! Digestion speed increases! 】
[It can store a large amount of overflow energy that cannot be digested at present, and instantly feed it back during battle or when it is exhausted! 】
The moment this faint green light lit up, the genetic medicine power in Jiang Yue's body that was on the verge of losing control seemed to have encountered a real natural enemy!
The stomach, which could only barely grind energy, now turned into a terrifying miniature black hole.
overbearing! Arrogant! Unreasonable devouring!
[Gluttony] The word "Gluttony" just turned slightly, and the blue medicinal power rushing through the blood vessels was instantly torn to pieces. It was forcibly squeezed and absorbed at an extremely terrifying speed, and melted perfectly.Into every inch of Jiang Yue's gene chain that is being reorganized!
